prompts.scout-body-v1: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: production game UV albedo texture atlas for Anarchy Online scout torso armour. Input image is the EDIT TARGET, not merely inspiration. Keep the two torso halves in precisely their existing locations. Do not create a character, mannequin, rendered suit, perspective, surrounding objects, extra UV islands, or a presentation sheet. Output only the flat full-bleed albedo image, preferably 2048x1024. Maintain black/graphite scout armour identity, but clearly separate satin gunmetal titanium plates, silver machined edges, dark woven flexible fabric and rubber seals. Replace blurry painted shine with crisp engineered panel edges, fine carbon textile weave, tiny inset fasteners, realistic restrained edge wear, layered panel details and a few tiny warm-amber status inlays. Broad silhouette and original panel layout stay exactly fixed; detail is added within existing surfaces. Flat neutral diffuse material colour for physically based rendering: no baked highlights, no cast shadows, no dramatic lighting, no glow bloom. Brighter readable metal panels against dark fabric, no text, logos, watermarks or labels. Preserve the existing left/right continuity and seams so the atlas can be applied to the original mesh without changing its UVs.
